highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 advances to Skia m156 with expanded .NET, GTK4, Tizen, and Linux support.
highlights_body: The release restores Linux system-font discovery for NoDependencies packages, adds native GTK4 GPU rendering, and aligns native assets with .NET 11 previews.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to Skia m156 and incorporates the current core fork cleanup.

bullets.lead: Linux NoDependencies packages find system fonts again
bullets.detail: Restores system-font discovery for Linux applications using the NoDependencies package variant.

bullets.lead: GTK4 applications gain native GPU rendering
bullets.detail: Adds native GTK4 GPU rendering with correct pixel scaling for supported GTK4 hosts.
Updates WebAssembly native assets and package pins for .NET 11 preview consumers.
Adds GCC 14.2-based native builds and packaging for the Tizen 10 target.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored Linux system-font discovery for the NoDependencies package variant
